executeFeedChange(address).details: The suspension is the point: a feed change must never silently re-point what a vault is marked at.      Resuming is a separate explicit `setNavSuspended(bondToken, false)`.

getInstrumentConfig(address).details: Reverts for an unregistered instrument: no zero-valued fallback, ever.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

isRegistered(address).details: The guard hook and `previewNav` rely on this being total.

proposeClearRecoveryNav(address).details: R2-1: this carries the SAME delay as installing an override. The earlier reasoning — that      restoring the feed "cannot be used to install a number" — was wrong: the feed can hold a fresh,      in-bounds par value while the override records a credit impairment, so an immediate clear raises      the mark from the impaired figure to par in one transaction (40 -> 100 cash units in the      reproduction), and reopens the feed-based tradability path. Freshness and the circuit breaker      validate the feed's ordinary range, not whether it should supersede a recorded credit event.

proposeFeedChange(address,address,uint8,.details: F6: THE BOUNDS TRAVEL WITH THE FEED. A replacement whose `decimals()` differ needs bounds in its      own units. Previously only `navFeedScale` was refreshed, so an 8-decimal feed replaced by an      economically identical 18-decimal one left the old ceiling in place and tripped the circuit      breaker on every normal value, with no setter to repair it.

params.maxAnswer: Circuit-breaker ceiling in the NEW feed's units; zero disables that side
params.minAnswer: Circuit-breaker floor in the NEW feed's units; zero disables that side

proposeRecoveryNav(address,uint256).details: A non-zero recovery NAV replaces the feed entirely. This is the "agree recovery behaviour rather      than assuming repayment at par" control: par is a choice someone must make explicitly, not a default.

registerInstrument((address,uint256,addr.details: Reverts rather than defaulting on every field that could silently mis-value a holding. In particular      a USD-denominated NAV feed with no cash feed is rejected outright: that combination is the      "assume cash equals one dollar" bug, and it must be impossible to configure.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setEmergencyExit(address,uint32,uint16).details: Pass (0, 0) to CLOSE it. That is the one zero this setter accepts, because closing an incident      control must stay possible — unlike `setTradeFloors`, where zero could only ever brick a leg.Only widens a TIME window, never lowers the price reference. See the field NatSpec for why a      stale NAV cannot underprice this leg; the governed risk is `discountBps`, capped as elsewhere.

params.discountBps: The wider exit discount applying inside the window; 0 = off
params.maxPublicationAge: Seconds of publication staleness a SELL may still price against; 0 = off

setMaxPpsAge(uint256).details: Mirrors `setStalenessBounds`: a freshness tolerance, role-gated, not timelocked. Bounded by      `MAX_AGE_CEILING` so a mis-signed configuration cannot authorise a year-old PPS.

params.newMaxPpsAge: Seconds; 0 stores as UNCONFIGURED and the policy then refuses to trade

setNavSuspended(address,bool).details: Use this for a credit event, a feed failure, or maturity. Suspension makes every value read revert      while identity reads (`decimals`, `getBalanceOfOwner`) keep working, so holdings stay visible and      only NAV-sensitive actions are blocked.

setTradeFloors(address,uint16,uint16).details: F1: these bound `GyldTradePolicy.validateFill`, which measures observed balance deltas, so they      cap value leakage per trade even when the caller's header `outputMin` is permissive.NOT timelocked, matching `setStalenessBounds` above: both are risk tolerances rather than      valuations, and the two timelocked paths in this contract (`recoveryNav`, feed changes) both      change what an instrument is WORTH. Loosening is the fail-open direction and is deliberately      left as a single role-gated transaction so an incident can be responded to at incident speed —      alert on `TradeFloorsUpdated` and treat a widening as an event needing a reason.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

BPS_DENOMINATOR().notice: Basis-point denominator for the trade-floor tolerances

DEREGISTER_DELAY().notice: Delay on changes that alter what a holding is worth

FEED_KIND_CHAINLINK().notice: `navFeedKind` for a Chainlink-style `AggregatorV3` feed: publication time only, no observation time

FEED_KIND_GYLD_NATIVE().notice: `navFeedKind` for a Gyld-native feed exposing both observation and publication time

MAX_AGE_CEILING().notice: Upper bound on any configurable age, so a mis-signed configuration cannot authorise a year-old NAV

MAX_TOLERANCE_BPS().notice: Hard ceiling on either trade-floor tolerance, in bps (20%).

cancelClearRecoveryNav(address).notice: Withdraws a pending clear proposal, keeping the override in force.

cancelFeedChange(address).notice: F5: withdraws a pending feed change.

cancelRecoveryNav(address).notice: F5: withdraws a pending recovery proposal. Re-proposing only restarts a clock; it is not         cancellation, and a stale matured proposal is executable forever without this.

executeClearRecoveryNav(address).notice: Executes a matured clear proposal, returning the instrument to feed-based valuation.

executeFeedChange(address).notice: Applies a proposed feed change and FORCE-SUSPENDS valuation as a side effect

getInstrumentConfig(address).notice: Full configuration for a registered instrument

isApprovedPair(address,address).notice: Whether `cashToken` is the configured cash denomination for `bondToken`. NEVER reverts.

isRegistered(address).notice: Whether an instrument is registered. NEVER reverts.

maxPpsAge().notice: Max age of the SuperVault aggregator's price-per-share observation a trade may rely on.

pendingClearRecoveryNavAt(address).notice: R2-1: removing an override is as much a valuation change as installing one, so it carries the         same delay. Clearing hands the mark back to the feed, which may be a fresh, in-bounds par         value, so an immediate clear could lift an impaired mark to par in a single transaction.

pendingFeedMinAnswer(address).notice: F6: bounds travel WITH the feed change. A replacement feed with different decimals needs         bounds in its own units, and leaving the old ones in place made every normal value trip the         circuit breaker.

proposeClearRecoveryNav(address).notice: F4: proposes removal of a terminal override, returning the instrument to its feed. A SEPARATE         action from recording a recovery of zero, which is a total loss and keeps the override in force.

proposeRecoveryNav(address,uint256).notice: Proposes a terminal valuation override for default or maturity

setMaxPpsAge(uint256).notice: Sets the max age of the aggregator's price-per-share observation a trade may rely on

setNavSuspended(address,bool).notice: Stops or resumes valuation of an instrument. NOT timelocked, by design.

setStalenessBounds(address,uint256,uint2.notice: Updates the staleness bounds for an instrument
